capabilities: Practise seven question formats stored as note properties
Run timed multi-section tests with exam tools
Schedule question, card and whole-note review with spaced repetition
Import documents and ready-made flashcard decks
Track classes, assignments, grades and study statistics
disambiguation: Not only a score tracker for multiple-choice questions; it also runs timed tests, flashcards, a calendar and an optional AI tutor.
extras: Document import (PDF, PowerPoint, Word and others) requires AI features plus a provider key or the OpenCode agent; there is no offline converter. Free, MIT-licensed, no telemetry, and no account required.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to practise exam-style questions from your notes and schedule each one for review.

relations.evidence: keep decks in step with a running Anki desktop through the AnkiConnect add-on
AI is optional and uses your own provider key or the OpenCode desktop agent

summary: Study plugin that turns notes and PDFs into practice questions, with timed tests, confidence ratings, mistake tags and spaced review.
